retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, warm-toned layout featuring two central figures against a tropical sunset backdrop with bold, outlined display typography.
triggerTerms: bold outlined title over tropical background

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition featuring two male figures in the foreground, one looking stern and the other smiling, set against a saturated orange and yellow sunset with palm tree silhouettes and a circular call-out badge.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground figures overlapping a warm gradient background
Bold display text anchored at the bottom center
Circular graphic element containing secondary information on the left
High-contrast lighting emphasizing facial features and clothing textures
coreInvariants: Warm orange-to-yellow sunset gradient background with palm silhouettes
Two-person character dynamic with contrasting expressions
Heavy-weight outlined display typography for the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures occupy the middle and foreground, scaled to fill approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, outlined title text at the bottom center serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the faces of the subjects, move down to the circular badge on the left, and finish at the large title text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, filled with saturated sunset colors and palm tree silhouettes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm orange and yellow sunset tones in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark red in the foreground clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and white outlines on the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high value contrast between the dark figures and the bright sky.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif and slab-serif forms.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title text features a secondary color outline to create a 'glowing' or 'sticker' effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display slab-serif paired with a condensed sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Circular dark badge with white text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the display text.
Matches the slab-serif characteristics of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a tropical sunset scene with a vibrant orange and yellow gradient sky, featuring dark silhouettes of palm trees and two men in the foreground (one serious, one smiling) wearing athletic/casual urban attire.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-line stacked title in the bottom center using a heavy slab-serif font with a white fill and a thick cyan outline. Add a circular black badge on the left with small white sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm sunset gradient?
Are the palm tree silhouettes visible?
Is the title text bold, uppercase, and outlined?
Is there a circular badge on the left side?

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between subjects and text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure title text is heavy and outlined
Confirm presence of palm tree silhouettes
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a tropical sunset backdrop with urban character photography and heavy, outlined display typography to recreate the early 2000s action-comedy aesthetic.
